result.title: Perception, Not Reasoning, Limits Visual Theory of Mind
result.comment: 36 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (E&D). Code and dataset: https://kurbanintelligencelab.github.io/perception-not-reasoning/
result.summary: Vision-language models pass text-based false-belief probes at near-human levels but drop by over twenty percentage points on abstract panels the moment the same problem is conveyed visually. The consensus diagnosis is conceptual, prescribing new belief-reasoning modules. We argue the dominant bottleneck is perceptual: not what the model cannot reason about, but what it cannot see. We propose a five-condition dissociation protocol that holds the reasoning task constant while varying perceptual fidelity from visual only to text only, and quantify the result with the Perceptual Contribution Ratio, the share of the visual-to-text gap a given fidelity closes. We test this on two kinds of scenes: abstract 2D panels in the Heider--Simmel tradition, and naturalistic 3D game scenes from MuMA-ToM and MindPower. The evaluation covers seven VLMs and roughly 159,000 API calls. Ground-truth scaffolds substantially close the gap in every setting, and on the abstract panels and MuMA-ToM they match or exceed the text-only reasoning. Whereas scaffolds built by automatic parsers, including frontier VLMs, fail. The most common error in the visual-only condition is \emph{reality bias}, which accounts for 60\% of false-belief failures. Models report where an object actually is, not where an absent agent believes it is. This points to a perceptual front-end that fails to track which agents were present at each moment. Under the evaluated protocol, structured visual scene-state extraction, rather than belief inference, is the dominant bottleneck for visual ToM.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出五条件解离协议：保持推理任务不变、把同一问题的感知输入从纯视觉渐变到纯文本，并用 Perceptual Contribution Ratio 量化各保真度能弥合多少视觉—文本差距；在抽象二维面板与两个自然 3D 游戏场景上评测七个 VLM（约 15.9 万次 API 调用），发现真实场景状态脚手架可基本闭合差距，而自动解析器（含前沿 VLM）构造的脚手架无效。
AI.relevance_reason: 该诊断把视觉 ToM 瓶颈定位在感知前端（是否追踪各时刻在场 agent、能否抽取出结构化场景状态），而非信念推理，并报告视觉条件下 60% 的错误为「reality bias」，与 LVR 关注的视觉细节保留、视觉证据筛选与信息坍缩直接相关，值得核查视觉通路是否只传递物体实际位置而丢失任务必要状态。
